name: Exp_JMACandleSign
summary: This EA trades based on signals from the custom JMACandleSign indicator, which generates buy/sell signals based on JMA-smoothed candlestick patterns. It opens buy positions on upward signals and sell positions on downward signals, with configurable position closing logic and money management options.
summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义JMACandleSign指标的信号进行交易，该指标根据JMA平滑的K线形态产生买入/卖出信号。它在上涨信号时开多仓，在下跌信号时开空仓，具有可配置的平仓逻辑和资金管理选项。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于JMACandleSign自定义指标，该指标使用JMA（Jurik移动平均）平滑算法处理K线数据并生成方向性信号。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区1（UpValue）在指定信号K线上出现非零非空值时开多仓，当缓冲区0（DnValue）出现非零非空值时开空仓。出场条件分为两类：反向信号平仓（如上涨信号出现时平空仓，下跌信号出现时平多仓）以及固定的止损/止盈平仓。仓位管理支持五种模式：按自由保证金比例、按余额比例、按减去亏损后的自由保证金比例、按减去亏损后的余额比例、以及固定手数模式。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，MMMode参数选择计算模式，默认使用固定手数模式（LOT）。EA还包含历史数据加载机制和新K线检测逻辑，避免在同一K线内重复交易。当开仓和平仓条件同时启用但未检测到平仓信号时，EA会回溯历史K线寻找最近的反向信号作为平仓依据。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the JMACandleSign custom indicator, which uses the JMA (Jurik Moving Average) smoothing algorithm to process candlestick data and generate directional signals. Entry conditions are: a buy position opens when indicator buffer 1 (UpValue) shows a non-zero, non-EMPTY_VALUE on the specified signal bar, and a sell position opens when buffer 0 (DnValue) shows a non-zero, non-EMPTY_VALUE. Exit conditions fall into two categories: reverse-signal closing (e.g., closing sell positions when an up signal appears, closing buy positions when a down signal appears) and fixed stop-loss/take-profit closing. Position sizing supports five modes: by free margin percentage, by balance percentage, by free margin minus losses percentage, by balance minus losses percentage, and fixed lot mode. Money management is controlled via the MM parameter for risk ratio and the MMMode parameter for calculation mode, defaulting to fixed lot mode (LOT). The EA also includes a history data loading mechanism and new bar detection logic to prevent repeated trading within the same bar. When both opening and closing conditions are enabled but no closing signal is detected, the EA backtracks through historical bars to find the most recent reverse signal as a closing basis.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理比例或固定手数
parameters.description_en: Money management ratio or fixed lot size

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式（自由保证金/余额/扣除亏损后的保证金/扣除亏损后的余额/固定手数）
parameters.description_en: Position sizing mode (free margin/balance/loss-free margin/loss-balance/fixed lot)

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 用于检测交易信号的K线索引
parameters.description_en: Bar index used for signal detection

pros: JMA平滑算法减少了虚假信号，相比普通移动平均线更灵敏且更平滑
提供灵活的资金管理模式，支持五种仓位计算方式适应不同交易需求
开仓和平仓逻辑可独立配置，允许只开仓不平仓或只平仓不开仓的灵活组合
新K线检测机制防止同一K线内重复交易
止损止盈参数可配置，提供基本的风险控制
pros_en: JMA smoothing algorithm reduces false signals, being more responsive and smoother than standard moving averages
Flexible money management with five position sizing modes to suit different trading needs
Opening and closing logic can be independently configured, allowing combinations like open-only or close-only
New bar detection mechanism prevents repeated trading within the same bar
Configurable stop-loss and take-profit parameters provide basic risk control
cons: 依赖外部自定义指标JMACandleSign，若指标文件缺失则EA无法运行
回溯历史K线寻找平仓信号的逻辑效率较低，在K线数量多时可能导致性能问题
缺少点差过滤机制，在高点差环境下可能产生不利成交
止损1000点和止盈2000点的默认值偏大，可能不适合所有品种
代码中大量注释为乱码（编码问题），影响代码可读性和维护
cons_en: Depends on external custom indicator JMACandleSign; EA fails if the indicator file is missing
Backtracking historical bars for closing signals is inefficient and may cause performance issues with many bars
No spread filter mechanism, which may lead to unfavorable fills in high-spread environments
Default stop-loss of 1000 points and take-profit of 2000 points are large and may not suit all instruments
Many comments are garbled due to encoding issues, hurting readability and maintainability
improvements: 添加点差过滤和交易时间过滤，避免在高点差和非交易时段开仓
优化回溯平仓逻辑，限制最大回溯K线数量或使用缓存机制提高效率
增加持仓检查和重复订单防护逻辑，避免在极端情况下重复开仓
improvements_en: Add spread filter and trading session filter to avoid opening positions during high spreads and off-hours
Optimize the bar backtracking closing logic by limiting maximum backtrack bars or using a caching mechanism for efficiency
Add position check and duplicate order protection logic to prevent repeated position opening in extreme cases

risk_points: 默认止损和止盈点数较大，在波动性较低的品种上可能造成不必要的风险
缺少点差过滤，在流动性不足时可能以不利价格成交
回溯历史K线平仓逻辑在极端市场条件下可能找不到合适的平仓信号导致延迟平仓
risk_points_en: Default stop-loss and take-profit values are large, potentially creating unnecessary risk on low-volatility instruments
No spread filter may result in unfavorable fill prices during low liquidity conditions
The bar backtracking closing logic may fail to find appropriate closing signals in extreme market conditions, leading to delayed exits

It opens buy positions on upward signals and sell positions on downward signals, with configurable position closing logic and money management options.
